title: Value of Reward Points That Cannot Be Clawed Back, Added to a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Fee
content:
The value of reward points that cannot be clawed back is then added. Where the profile's membership stands active and its reward point balance now stands at nothing, the value of the whole of the points the line earned at the tier's published redemption rate is added, because none of them can be taken back off a balance that is empty. Where the membership stands active and its balance stands above nothing but below the points the line earned, the value of the part that cannot be taken back, that is the points the line earned less the balance now standing, is added at that rate. In any other case nothing is added, because the points the line earned are taken back off the balance instead.

## What is read, and how a value is worked out

The membership read is the one standing on the customer's profile on Northbeam Circle Membership: whether it stands active, the reward point balance standing on it now, and the redemption rate its tier publishes for each hundred points. The points the line earned are the reward points accrued on the order the returned line was bought on, taken from that membership's ledger.

The value of a number of points at that rate is that number multiplied by the rate the tier publishes for each hundred points, divided by one hundred, and rounded to the cent. The addition to the Northbeam Returns and Restocking fee is that value.

| The membership | The balance standing now | Points whose value is added |
| --- | --- | --- |
| active | nothing | the whole of the points the line earned |
| active | above nothing but below the points the line earned | the points the line earned, less the balance now standing |
| active | the points the line earned or more | none, and nothing is added |
| not active | any | none, and nothing is added |

## Points of judgement

**Why an empty balance adds the whole of the points.** None of them can be taken back off a balance that is empty.

**Why a balance at or above the points the line earned adds nothing.** The points the line earned are taken back off the balance instead.

## Worked through on hypothetical inputs

*A membership standing active, its tier publishing 1.20 USD for each hundred points, the line having earned 900 points, the balance standing at nothing.* The whole 900 points are valued: 900 multiplied by 1.20 USD is 1080.00, divided by one hundred is 10.80 USD, and 10.80 USD is added.

*The same membership and rate, the line having earned 900 points, the balance standing at 400 points.* Four hundred is above nothing and below 900, so 500 points cannot be taken back: 500 multiplied by 1.20 USD, divided by one hundred, is 6.00 USD, and 6.00 USD is added.

*The same membership and rate, the line having earned 900 points, the balance standing at 900 points.* The balance is not below the points earned, so nothing is added.

*A membership that does not stand active, the balance standing at nothing.* Nothing is added.
